requirements.title: External-file access methods are sequential, direct, and stream
requirements.definition: There are three methods of accessing external-file data: sequential, direct, and stream.

pending.sequential-access-method: Use a future sequential connection and known ordered records; assert record-order effects owned by sequential access.
pending.direct-access-method: Use a future direct connection with REC= on known record numbers; assert record-number recovery, not physical order.
pending.stream-access-method: Use a future stream connection with POS= inquiry or positioning; assert data at an identified position, not byte representation.

requirements.oracle: Plans are pending and source-derived. Positive plans establish a non-default state first (for example by writing known records, initializing variables to nonzero/nonblank sentinels, or creating a known file) and then observe only portable properties: exact internal records, successful IOSTAT zero, nonzero IOSTAT for a specified error condition, or named intrinsic status values where the standard names them. Processor-dependent unit numbers, file names, record lengths, storage-unit encodings, buffering, timing, IOMSG text, and specific error numbers are not asserted.

Negative plans are source-control plans unless this unit itself requires rejection and a future fixture can observe the rejection portably. IOMSG wording and processor-dependent numeric status values are never an oracle.

requirements.title: Allowed access methods can vary by file and processor
requirements.definition: Some files may allow more than one access method and other files may be restricted to one access method.

pending.multiple-access-methods-permitted: No portable oracle may require a file to support multiple methods; future tests must guard any cross-method behavior with processor support.
pending.single-access-method-restriction-permitt: No portable oracle may fail a processor merely because a particular file is restricted to one access method.

requirements.title: A file access method is determined at connection or preconnected-file creation
requirements.definition: The method of accessing a file is determined when the file is connected to a unit or when the file is created if it is preconnected.

pending.access-method-determined-at-connection: OPEN a controlled file with ACCESS= after OPEN is registered and use an access-specific operation; assert the operation matching the connection succeeds.
pending.preconnected-access-method-determined-at: No portable oracle exists without a processor-described preconnected file; future tests must record the preconnected method through INQUIRE where available.

review_rationale: Source registration for Clause 12 (batch145), the clause's first packet. Every base and fine unit classified and hash-verified against the pinned J3/24-007 census by an independent fresh-context reviewer who read the original pages 242-246 and confirmed 12.3.3.4 ends before 12.3.4.1. Mixed obligation/latitude units were swept in both directions and all splits recorded; no unit left unresolved; no numbered R/C rule in scope; no requirement based on a NOTE; no no-portable-oracle claim found to be over-suppression and no pending plan found vacuous.
